study_form.studyName: A Genomic Catalog of Earth's Microbiomes
study_form.description: This study presents a genomic catalog of Earth's microbiomes constructed from metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) recovered from publicly available metagenomes. Soil samples were collected from globally distributed sites spanning diverse biomes — tropical forest, Arctic tundra, temperate grassland, and arid shrubland — to characterize microbial community structure and functional potential across terrestrial ecosystems. DNA was extracted and subjected to shotgun metagenomic sequencing to recover draft-quality MAGs representing previously uncultivated microbial lineages.
study_form.notes: Samples stored at -80C prior to DNA extraction.
